natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for the ERC-1155 Pausable extension recipe — registers the IPausable interface (ERC-165; `_paused` is the zero default) and grants `admin_` the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE that gates `pause()`/`unpause()`. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} (through {MultiInit}) inside the initializing window opened by the diamond, alongside the base {ERC1155Init}; it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer. The {ERC1155Pausable} facet adds no ERC-165 id of its own.
